dn11:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Nāḷandāyaṃ viharati Pāvārikambavane.
dn11:1.3: Atha kho Kevaddho gahapati-putto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Kevaddho gahapati-putto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:1.4: ‘Ayaṃ bhante Nāḷandā iddhā c' eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇa-manussā Bhagavati abhippasannā.
dn11:1.5: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu, yo uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati.
dn11:1.6: Evāyaṃ Nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya Bhagavati abhippasīdissatīti.'
dn11:1.7: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Kevaddhaṃ gahapati-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:1.8: ‘Na kho ahaṃ Kevaddha bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desemi:
dn11:1.9: "Etha tumhe bhikkhave gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karothāti."' 2.
dn11:2.1: Dutiyam pi kho Kevaddho gahapati-putto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:2.4: "Ayaṃ bhante Nāḷandā iddhā c' eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇa-manussā Bhagavati abhippasannā.
dn11:2.5: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu yo uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati.
dn11:2.6: Evāyaṃ Nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya Bhagavati abhipasīdissatīti.'
dn11:2.7: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā Kevaddhaṃ gahapati-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:2.8: ‘Na kho ahaṃ Kevaddha bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desemi:
dn11:2.9: "Etha tumhe bhikkhave gihīnaṃ odāta-vasanānaṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karothāti."' 3.
dn11:3.1: Tatiyam pi kho Kevaddho gahapati-putto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:3.4: "Ayaṃ bhante Nāḷandā iddhā c' eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇa-manussā Bhagavati abhippasannā.
dn11:3.5: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu yo uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati.
dn11:3.6: Evāyaṃ Nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya Bhagavati abhippasīdissatīti.'
dn11:3.8: ‘Tīṇi kho imāni Kevaddha pāṭihāriyāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
dn11:4.2: Idha Kevaddha bhikkhu aneka-vihitaṃ iddhi-vidhaṃ paccanubhoti. Eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhā pi hutvā eko hoti. Āvi-bhāvaṃ tiro-bhāvaṃ tiro-kuḍḍaṃ tiro-pākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathā pi ākāse, paṭhaviyā pi ummujja-nimujjaṃ karoti seyyathā pi udake, udake pi abhijjamāno gacchati seyyathā pi paṭhaviyaṃ, ākāse pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathā pi pakkhī sakuṇo, ime pi candima-suriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati parimajjati, yāva Brahma-lokā pi kāyena va saṃvatteti.
dn11:4.3: Tam enaṃ aññataro saddho pasanno passati taṃ bhikkhuṃ aneka-vihitaṃ iddhi-vidhaṃ paccanubhontaṃ eko pi hutvā bahudhā bhontaṃ, bahudhā pi hutvā eko bhontaṃ, āvi-bhāvaṃ tiro-bhāvaṃ tiro-kuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiro-pabbataṃ asajjamānaṃ gacchantaṃ seyyathā pi ākāse, paṭhaviyā pi ummujja-nimujjaṃ karontaṃ seyyathā pi udake, udake pi abhijjamānaṃ gacchantaṃ seyyathā pi paṭhaviyaṃ, ākāse pi pallaṅkena kamantaṃ seyyathā pi pakkhī sakuṇo, ime pi candima-suriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasantaṃ parimajjantaṃ, yāva Brahma-lokā pi kāyena va saṃvattentaṃ. 5.
dn11:4.4: ‘Tam enaṃ so saddho pasanno aññatarassa assaddhassa appasannassa āroceti:
dn11:4.5: "Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
dn11:4.6: Amāham bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ aneka-vihitaṃ iddhi-vidhaṃ paccanubhontaṃ, eko pi hutvā bahudhā bhontam . . . pe . . . yāva Brahma-lokā pi kāyena va saṃvattentan ti."
dn11:5.1: Tam enaṃ so assaddho appasaddho tam saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
dn11:5.3: Tāya so bhikkhu aneka-vihitaṃ iddhi-vidhaṃ paccanubhoti. Eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti . . . pe . . . yāva Brahma-lokā pi kāyena va saṃvattetīti."
dn11:5.5: Api nu so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāti?'
dn11:5.7: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ Kevaddha iddhi-pāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno iddhi-pāṭihāriyena aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi. 6.
dn11:6.2: Idha Kevaddha bhikkhu parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittam pi ādisati cetasikam pi ādisati vitakkitam pi ādisati vicāritam pi ādisati:
dn11:6.3: "Evam pi te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti."
dn11:6.4: Tam enaṃ aññataro saddho pasanno passati taṃ bhikkhuṃ parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittam pi ādisantaṃ cetasikam pi ādisantaṃ vitakkitam pi ādisantaṃ vicāritam pi ādisantaṃ:
dn11:6.5: "Evam pi te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti." 7.
dn11:6.6: ‘Tam enaṃ so saddho pasanno aññatarassa assaddhassa appasannassa āroceti:
dn11:6.7: ‘Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
dn11:6.8: Amāhaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittam pi ādisantaṃ cetasikam pi ādisantaṃ vitakkitam pi ādisantaṃ vicāritam pi ādisantaṃ:
dn11:6.9: "Evam pi te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti."
dn11:7.1: Tam enaṃ so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
dn11:7.3: Tāya so bhikkhu parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittam pi ādisati cetasikam pi ādisati . . . pe . . .
dn11:7.4: evam pi te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti."
dn11:7.6: Api nu so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāti?'
dn11:7.8: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ Kevaddha ādesanā-pāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno ādesanā-pāṭihāriyena aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi. 8.
dn11:8.3: "Evaṃ vitakketha mā evam vitakkayittha, evam manasikarotha mā evaṃ manasākattha, idam pajahatha idaṃ upasampajja viharathāti."
dn11:9-66.1: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Kevaddha idha Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . . pe . . . yathā Sāmañña-phale
dn11:9-66.2: evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ . . . 44. ‘Tass' ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha -kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. So vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. So imam eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pīti-sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pīti-sukhena apphutaṃ hoti. 45. ‘Seyyathā pi Kevaddha dakkho nahāpako vā nahāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsa-thāle nahāniya-cuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sā 'ssa nahāniya-piṇḍi snehānugatā sneha-paretā santara-bāhirā phuṭā sinehena na ca paggharaṇī -- evam eva Kevaddha bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pīti-sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pīti-sukhena apphutaṃ hoti. Idam pi vuccati
dn11:9-66.8: Idam pi vuccati Kevaddha anusāsani-pāṭihāriyaṃ. 52. ‘So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudu-bhūte kammaniye ṭhite ānejjappatte
dn11:67.1: ‘Imāni kho Kevaddha tīṇi pāṭihāriyāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
dn11:67.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ Kevaddha imasmiṃ yeva bhikkhu-saṃghe aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn11:67.4: "Kattha nu kho ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:68.1: Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu tathā-rūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji yathā samāhite citte devayāniyo maggo pātur ahosi. 68.
dn11:68.2: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena Cātummahārājikā devā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Cātummahārājike deve etad avoca:
dn11:68.3: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:68.4: ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha Cātummahārājikā devā taṃ bhikkhum etad avocuṃ:
dn11:68.6: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu, tejo-dhātu, vāyo-dhātu.
dn11:68.7: Atthi kho bhikkhu cattāro Mahārājā amhehi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
dn11:68.9: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātūti."' 69.
dn11:69.1: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena cattāro Mahārājā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā cattāro Mahārāje etad avoca:
dn11:69.2: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo- dhātūti ?"
dn11:69.3: ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha cattāro Mahārājā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn11:69.5: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī- dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātu.
dn11:69.6: Atthi kho bhikkhu Tāvatiṃsā nāma devā amhehi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
dn11:69.8: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti." 70.
dn11:70.1: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena Tāvatiṅsā devā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Tāvatiṅse deve etad avoca:
dn11:70.2: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:70.3: ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha Tāvatiṅsā devā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn11:70.5: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo- dhātu .
dn11:70.6: Atthi kho bhikkhu Sakko nāma devānam indo amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
dn11:70.8: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti." 71.
dn11:71.1: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena Sakko devānam indo ten upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:71.2: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:71.3: ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha Sakko devānam indo taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
dn11:71.5: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, sey yathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātu.
dn11:72.1: Atthi kho bhikkhu Yāmā nāma devā amhehi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca. Te kho etaṃ jāneyyuṃ yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti." 72. ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena Yāmā devā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Yāme deve etad avoca: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyodhātūti?" "Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha Yāmā devā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ: "Mayam pi kho bhikkhu na jānāma yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātu. Atthi kho bhikkhu
dn11:73.1: Suyāmo nāma deva-putto amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. dn11:75.1: amhehi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca. Atthi kho bhikkhu
dn11:76.1: Nimmānaratī nāma devā amhehi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca. dn11:77.1: Sunimmito nāma deva-putto amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. dn11:77.2: ParanimmitaVasavattī devā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Paranimmita-Vasavattī deve etad avoca: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . vāyo-dhātūti?" ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha Paranimmita-Vasavattī devā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ: "Mayam pi kho bhikkhu na jānāma yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātu. dn11:79.8: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti." 80.
dn11:80.1: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu tathā-rūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji yathā samāhite citte Brahma-yāniyo maggo pātur ahosi.
dn11:80.2: Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena Brahma-kāyikā devā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Brahma-kāyike deve etad avoca:
dn11:80.3: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:80.4: ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha Brahma-kāyikā devā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn11:80.6: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātu.
dn11:80.7: Atthi kho bhikkhu Brahmā Mahā-brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu-daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūtā-bhavyānaṃ amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
dn11:80.9: yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti."
dn11:80.10: "‘Kahaṃ pan' āvuso etarahi so Mahā-brahmā ti?"
dn11:80.11: "‘Mayam pi kho bhikkhu na jānāma yattha vā Brahmā yena vā Brahmā yahiṃ vā Brahmā.
dn11:80.12: Api ca bhikkhu yathā nimittā dissanti āloko sañjāyati obhāso pātu bhavati Brahmā pātu bhavissati . Brahmuno etaṃ pubbe nimittaṃ pātubhāvāya yad idaṃ āloko sañjāyati obhāso pātu bhavatīti." 81.
dn11:81.1: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha Mahā-brahmā na cirass' eva pātur ahosi.
dn11:81.2: Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu yena so Mahā-brahmā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Brah mānaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:81.3: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavīdhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:81.4: ‘Evaṃ vutte Kevaddha so Mahā-brahmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:--
dn11:81.5: "‘Aham asmi bhikkhu Brahmā Mahā-brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu-daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūta-bhavyānan ti." 82.
dn11:82.1: ‘Dutiyam pi kho Kevaddha so bhikkhu taṃ Brah mānaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:82.2: "Na kho ahan taṃ āvuso evaṃ pucchāmi:
dn11:82.3: ‘Tvaṃ 'si Brahmā Mahā-brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu-daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūta-bhavyānan ti?'
dn11:82.4: Evañ ca kho ahan taṃ āvuso pucchāmi:
dn11:82.5: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti?"
dn11:82.6: ‘Dutiyam pi kho Kevaddha so Mahā-brahmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
dn11:82.7: "Aham asmi bhikkhu Brahmā Mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu-daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūta-bhavyānan ti." 83.
dn11:83.1: ‘Tatiyam pi kho Kevaddha so bhikkhu taṃ Mahābrahmānaṃ etad avoca:
dn11:83.2: "Na kho ahan taṃ āvuso evaṃ pucchāmi:
dn11:83.3: ‘Tvaṃ 'si Brahmā Mahā-brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu-daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūta-bhavyānan ti?"
dn11:83.4: Evañ ca kho ahan taṃ āvuso pucchāmi:
dn11:83.5: "Kattha nu kho āvuso ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātūti?"'
dn11:83.6: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha Mahā-brahmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ apanetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
dn11:83.7: "Idha bhikkhu Brahma-kāyikā devā evaṃ jānanti: ‘N' atthi kiñci Brahmuno adiṭṭhaṃ , n' atthi kiñci Brahmuno aviditam, n' atthi kiñci Brahmuno asacchikatan ti.' Tasmā
dn11:83.9: Aham pi kho bhikkhu na jānāmi yatth' ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu . . . pe . . . vāyo-dhātu.
dn11:83.10: Tasmāt iha bhikkhu tumh' ev' etaṃ dukkataṃ, tumh' ev' etaṃ aparaddhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ taṃ Bhagavantaṃ atisitvā bahiddhā pariyeṭṭhiṃ āpajjasi imassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya.
dn11:83.11: Gaccha tvaṃ bhikkhu tam eva Bhagavantaṃ upasaṃkamitvā imaṃ pañhaṃ puccha, yathā ca te Bhagavā vyākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsīti." 84.
dn11:84.1: ‘Atha kho so Kevaddha bhikkhu seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahma-loke antarahito mama purato pātur ahosi.
dn11:84.2: Atha kho Kevaddha bhikkhu maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Kevaddha so bhikkhu maṃ etad avoca:
dn11:84.3: "Kattha nu kho bhante ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyodhātūti?" 85.
dn11:85.1: ‘Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Kevaddha taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
dn11:85.2: "Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhu sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti.
dn11:85.3: Te atīra-dakkhiṇiyā nāvāya tīra-dassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti.
dn11:85.4: So gacchat' eva puratthimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ, gacchati anudisaṃ.
dn11:85.5: Sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathā gatako va hoti.
dn11:85.6: Sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tam eva nāvaṃ pacchāgacchati.
dn11:85.7: Evam eva kho tvaṃ bhikkhu yāva yato yāva Brahma-lokā pariyesamāno imassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ nājjhagā, atha maṃ yeva santike paccāgato.
dn11:85.8: Na kho eso bhikkhu pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo:
dn11:85.9: ‘Kattha nu kho bhante ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathīdaṃ paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātūti?'
dn11:85.10: Evañ ca kho eso bhikkhu pañho pucchitabbo:
